A0.reuse_basis: same model, trainer logic, seed, update count and per-update learning rate; deterministic algorithms were on

A1.update_schedule: 5 smoke updates + 6 passes x 14760 graphs = 88565 (identical to A0)
A1.learning_rate: lr(u) equals A0's per-update value: epoch_equiv = clip(ceil((u-5)/2952),1,30); lr = 1e-5 + 0.5*(1e-3 - 1e-5)*(1+cos(pi*(epoch_equiv-1)/29))

options.with_seed_check: A1 seed17, then A0 seed29 and A1 seed29 sequentially on 133 (three GPU runs) so the seed spread enters the decision rule.

stages.work: read the 36 unused native steps of the 328 train conditions with the unchanged reader native_element_graph.py; 11808 new graphs
stages.determinism_check: re-read 1 train case at its 9 seen steps and require byte-identical npz sha256 against the existing SCALE360 bundle before the full read
stages.gate: 328 PASS / 0 FAIL, exactly 11808 new files, per-file sha256 manifest
stages.untouched: 234 GPU and other user sessions (no GPU use in this stage)

stages.gate: per-file sha256 equal on 133; existing 2952 phase9 graphs reused by hash

stages.code: train_field_l12.py = train_field_scale360.py with four declared changes: plan path, 45 files per train case, per-update learning rate, train-set evaluation restricted to the 2952 phase9 graphs
stages.smoke: 5 updates then epoch-0 evaluation, as in A0
stages.in_run_evaluation: dev 9-phase and train phase9 subset at updates 5, 2957, 14765, 29525, 59045, 88565 (A0 epochs 0,1,5,10,20,30)
stages.checkpoint: last only, kept on 133; sha256 recorded

stages.work: evaluate_frozen_field_diagnostic.py on the A1 checkpoint over the existing 1440 dev graphs (bundle 5bf699ac...)

controls.STOP: STOP file in stage root or research root stops the owned process; partial files preserved
controls.identity: owner PID + process create time recorded in OWNER.json; guard receipt; only verified owned processes are stopped
controls.duplicate_guard: refuse to start if any owned L12 stage directory or live owned process exists
controls.stop_between_stages: each stage gate must PASS before the next starts; a failure stops the chain

outputs_to_publish: L12_PHASE45_RESULT.json (metrics per COMMON_EVALUATION_CONTRACT, hashes, wall times)
L12 snapshot and conductor CSVs (same schema as FROZEN_DIAGNOSTIC_*.csv)
L12_PHASE45_REPORT_KO.md with the decision against the preregistered rule and predictions P1-P4
not_published: graphs, checkpoints, raw HDF5, private host mappings

estimated_total.minimal: about 1.5 h wall (prepare 10 min, transfer about 15 min, train about 60 min, evaluate 2 min)
